differential.name: Iron‑deficiency anemia (or anemia of chronic disease)
differential.rationale: Low MCH (27.3 pg) with borderline high platelets (405 ×10³/µL) points to microcytic anemia.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Obesity (BMI 30.2), hypertension and daytime stress raise suspicion for sleep‑disordered breathing.

differential.name: Chronic sinusitis
differential.rationale: Documented chronic and acute bacterial sinusitis; contributes to systemic inflammation and platelet elevation.
